HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date of Agreement (2020-08-28) - matches the source
- Borrower name (Lilis Energy Inc., Nevada corporation) - matches the source  
- Subsidiary names (Brushy Resources Inc., Hurricane Resources LLC, etc.) - all match the source
- Administrative Agent (BMO Harris Bank N.A.) - matches the source
- Lender names (Capital One National Association, Credit Suisse AG Cayman Islands Branch) - match the source
- Transaction type (Third Amendment to Senior Secured Super-Priority Debtor-in-Possession Credit Agreement) - matches the source
- Milestone extension (August 28, 2020 to September 3, 2020) - matches Section 2.1 of the source
- Chapter 11 proceedings context - supported by the DIP nature of the facility
- Covenant terms mentioned (representation/warranty maintenance, no Default/Event of Default) - supported by Sections 3.2 and 4.3

The memo appropriately marks unavailable financial terms (deal size, interest rate, maturity, etc.) as "N/A" rather than fabricating information not present in the source document.

ANSWER: NO

MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all the key financial terms that are actually available in the source document. The source document is a limited amendment that only changes one date (from August 28, 2020 to September 3, 2020) and does not contain fundamental deal terms like loan amounts, interest rates, maturity dates, or detailed covenant structures. The memo correctly identifies these as "N/A" since they are not specified in this amendment document, and properly notes that this refers back to the original Credit Agreement dated June 30, 2020 for those terms. All material parties, the nature of the amendment, the bankruptcy context, and the milestone extension are properly captured.
